priorityList: Start from Stealth and cast Garrote.
Cast Deathmark together with DPS potion and on-use trinket.
Use Garrote again to refresh Improved Garrote duration.
Use Envenom with 7 Combo Points when Darkest Night triggers, otherwise at 5+ Combo Points.
Use Mutilate and Ambush (when available through Blindside) as builders.
Utilize purposeful downtime and play around gaps in the rotation rather than forcing a cast on every GCD.
Periodically allow the Envenom buff to drop to trigger energy return from the Implacable talent.
Prioritize Energy efficiency by selecting the most efficient ability for the situation.
Manage resources carefully to avoid overcapping Energy or Combo Points during pooling phases.
Plan the usage of cooldowns, bleeds, and resources around specific encounter timings.
Maintain bleeds and debuffs as the primary method of damage output.
Use Envenom as the primary Combo Point spender while managing its uptime for Implacable procs.
